regions.merged_text: VIII Grateful appreciation stressed again & again. 20 ... As the nations which the Lord destroyed at thy Entrance, so shall you also perish, if you be disobedient to the voice of the Lord your God." X - 6 ... And ... Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar succeeded him in the priestly office. 22 - In 70 souls went down into Egypt. XII - 2 Destroy all the places in which the nations you shall po- ssess, worshiped their gods upon high mountains and hills and under every shady tree. XXII - 5 A woman shall not be clothed with man's apparel, neither shall a man use woman's apparel; for he that doth these things is abomin- able before God. XXVII - 16 Cursed be he that honorath not his father and mother; and all the people shall say, Amen.

regions.merged_text: May 3rd Drive to Milwaukee. Pleasant Surprise in Chicago - unexpected dinner prepared at O'Ds. May 4th Unveiling of Statue - Fr. Steph's Thanks be to God -- Blessing of Rev. Mother M. Didelis at Notre Dame Convent in ptomane-poison, ambulanced to Hospital - delayed till Friday in same" In St. Joseph Hospital May 13 - 22 Sundays but not 2 weeks. Hard to believe! First two days seemed like weeks !!.. . . Experience quite worth while. Deo Gratias .... no sleep ....
